auth.title: Sign in

settings.title: Settings
settings.storage_persisted: Offline data is protected from automatic clean-up.
settings.storage_not_persisted: Install the app on your home screen so offline data is kept safely.
settings.privacy_text: Player data is only shown to people who need it. Photos of players under 18 require guardian consent. The federation can erase a player's personal data on request.

demo.title: Try the demo
demo.intro: Choose a role. Everything runs in your browser with example data, so you can't break anything.
demo.note: Demo with example data. Nothing is sent to a server; changes stay in this browser.
demo.banner: Demo · example data stays in this browser
demo.no_server: User accounts are managed on the server, which the demo doesn't have.

public.share_text: Anyone can follow fixtures, results and tables here, without signing in. No player details are shown.

discipline.rules_note: Suspensions come from submitted match reports and are served in the team’s next matches in the same competition. Postponed and cancelled matches do not count.
discipline.yellow_limit: Yellow cards for a one-match ban
discipline.red_ban: Matches banned for a red card
discipline.second_yellow_ban: Matches banned for a second yellow

transfer.intro: The new club applies, the current club releases the player, and then the federation approves.

confirm.approved: Approve the transfer of {{player}} to {{club}}? The player moves club right away.
